comment: Approved coverage exceptions. An entry without proof is a failure.

exceptions.reason: ScalarizeIf scalarOrEltWiderThan(0,64) on vectors is shadowed by literal rule 7 ClampScalarOrElt<0,s8,sMaxScalar>, whose NarrowScalar guard scalarWiderThan(0, sMaxScalar) is a strict superset (the bound is 64 on a 64-bit target and 32 on i386).
exceptions.proof: core.json X86_IMPLICIT_DEF#7 NarrowScalar predicate is scalarWiderThan(0, select(Subtarget.is64Bit() ? 64 : 32)); literal rule 14 predicate is opaque(anonymous_31) && isVector with anonymous_31 = scalarOrEltWiderThan(0,64). Every type that satisfies 14 also satisfies 7's guard, so the exhaustive C0-C3 first-match search finds no query whose first match is 14.

exceptions.reason: ClampMinNumElements<0, X86_s64, 2> guard requires a fixed vector of s64 with fewer than 2 elements, which LLT cannot represent.
exceptions.proof: Generated guard X86EvalRuleGuard10_9 is isFixedVector && element==s64 && numElements<2; LLT::fixed_vector requires at least 2 lanes; exhaustive C0-C3 domain search (class-pair+boundary+AS+guard atoms) finds no trigger.
